channel.title: Shopwise Kitchen Desk
channel.description: Air fryers and thermometers, read the way a spec sheet should be.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Basket and oven-style air fryers cook differently and fit differently. Compare the four things that actually separate them, with the numbers from three specific listings.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Four checks that turn a capacity claim into something you can compare: the unit, the split, the shape, and the number the listing does not give you.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The specification sheet tells you what is dishwasher safe and what the footprint is. It does not tell you how many parts you will wash. Here is how to work that out before buying.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: A multi-function appliance is a set of compromises sold as a set of features. Six questions that separate the functions you will use from the ones you are paying for.

item.title: Do you need a meat thermometer if your air fryer has presets?
item.description: Presets guess. A thermometer measures. The USDA minimum internal temperatures, what each type of thermometer is for, and when a preset is good enough.

item.title: Instant-read or wireless probe: which thermometer do you actually need?
item.description: An instant-read answers "is it done now". A wireless probe answers "tell me when it is done". Compare the two on what they measure, what they need, and what they cost you in attention.

item.title: What temperature should chicken, pork and leftovers actually reach?
item.description: The USDA minimum internal temperatures in one table, with the rest time, plus what to do with a reading that lands just under the line.

item.title: Quarts per square inch: the counter-space arithmetic nobody publishes
item.description: Divide nominal capacity by counter footprint and the three air fryers separate by more than a factor of two. The method, the sums, and why the answer is not the ranking you expect.
